specification.exact_target: Adjusted odds ratio for MACE associated with SIQIII and/or RBBB in the multivariate binary logistic regression model: OR=2.4; 95% CI: 1.04, 5.9; p=0.039.
specification.blind_target: The adjusted association between the combined ECG pattern (SIQIII and/or RBBB) and the occurrence of major adverse cardiovascular events during hospitalization, estimated in a multivariable binary logistic regression model adjusting for the other independent predictors.
specification.target_location: Results, multivariate logistic regression for MACE; Table 2 (Independent predictors of MACEs), first row.

method_quotes.quote: A Kaplan–Meier survival analysis was performed to assess the association between the RBBB and/or SIQIII and overall mortality using the log-rank test. In order to identify the independent factors associated with the occurrence of MACEs, univariate and multivariate analyses were performed. First, covariates with a p-value less than or equal to 0.20 were retained in the

multivariable model. Then, a binary logistic regression was performed for assessing the independent risk factors for MACEs. Associations were reported as adjusted Odds Ratios (aOR) with 95% Confidence Interval (95% CI). A p-value≤0.05 was considered as statistically significant.
Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE) were defined as

the presence of at least one of the following: death during hospitalization, cardiogenic shock in initial presentation or the presence of a thrombus in the right heart. Renal failure was defined as an eGFR < 60 ml/min per 1.73 m 2 .
Complete RBBB was identified according to the Minnesota Code criteria (7-2-1) as a QRS duration must be ≥120 ms in addition to R′ wave>R wave in lead V1 and/or V2 in most beats of leads I, II, III,

SIQIII-type ECG patterns were defined as a qualitative presence of S wave in lead I and Q wave in lead III. Right ventricular dysfunction (RVD) was defined as a decreased systolic function of the RV (TAPSE <17 mm) and/or the presence of a paradoxical interventricular septal movement and/or a systolic pulmonary artery pressure ≥40 mmHg.

specification.input_notes: Single Figshare deposit (accession 22153379), file 'EP registre 2023 MONASTIR _ KAIROUAN final - SAFE HARBOR.sav' (61,860 bytes), SPSS .sav format. It is the underlying patient-level registry; the analysis variables (group membership, RBBB, SIQIII, MACE components, renal failure, troponin, RVD, right heart failure symptoms) must be derived from it. No codebook or variable dictionary is deposited.

specification.comparison_metric: Re-estimate the multivariable binary logistic regression for MACE with the same covariates and compare the adjusted odds ratio, 95% confidence interval and p-value for SIQIII and/or RBBB to the reported values.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Scalars within the displayed rounding bin: OR to one decimal (2.4), 95% CI bounds to the displayed precision (1.04, 5.9), p-value at reported precision (0.039).
specification.specification_gaps: Exact list of covariates entered into the univariate screen and the final model is not fully enumerated; handling of missing data is unspecified; exact coding of 'SIQIII and/or RBBB' as a single binary variable is not detailed; whether the model used complete cases or imputation is unstated; the SPSS variable names and value labels in the .sav are not documented.
